title: Consolidated egress patterns module with conditional NAT & endpoint attachments
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a single, opinionated Terraform module that implements common egress topologies for private (VPC) deployments. The module should support: 1) conditional NAT Gateway vs. managed NAT instances based on cost/perf profile; 2) optional Internet Gateway configuration for public subnets; 3) attachable VPC Endpoint resources (interface and gateway) with per-endpoint policy defaults; 4) route table generation per subnet class and auto-association; 5) route propagation and static failover routing patterns for multi-AZ resilience; and 6) built-in health-check hooks and a lightweight synthetic probe that reports endpoint/NAT reachability to the console metrics pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module exposes clear inputs for egress_mode (nat_gateway|nat_instance|egress_vpn), public_subnet_flags, endpoint_list, and route_priorities
Module provisions NAT (or managed NAT instances) per-AZ when configured and creates EIPs only when using NAT Gateway
VPC endpoints (S3 gateway, DynamoDB, and configurable interface endpoints) are created when requested and attach correct route table entries
Module emits a small status object to the monitoring stack (CloudWatch/Prometheus) indicating NAT/endpoint health via a synthetic probe job
Automated upgrade path: module versioning supports in-place upgrades with documented state migration steps and no downtime for read-only workloads
decisions: Use conditional creation to avoid forcing NAT Gateways for low-cost customers; default to NAT Gateway for P1 performance deployments
Implement endpoint policies as configurable JSON templates with sensible defaults to avoid accidental open access
Prefer provider-agnostic Terraform constructs where possible but include AWS-specific optimizations (EIP allocation, gateway attachments) behind flags
Expose an optional 'egress_proxy' output to allow higher-level stacks to route through managed proxies for inspection/audit
progress_updates: 2025-02-18: RFC drafted; initial module interface (inputs/outputs) proposed in the design doc; linked Confluence page
2025-02-19: Spike completed comparing cost tradeoffs between NAT Gateway vs NAT instance for heavy burst workloads; decided to support both with cost-based defaults
2025-02-20: Implemented prototype for conditional creation and per-AZ EIP allocation in sandbox account; synthetic probe PoC running via a Lambda job
2025-02-22: Integration tests added for gateway + endpoint creation; found race condition in route table association (fixed by explicit depends_on in module)
review_feedback: PM (Sofia Martinez): please add a mode that preserves source IP for backend telemetry (we need client IP for request attribution)
Security (Noah Blake): require security_review_required and ensure endpoint policies default to least privilege; audit logging must be enabled for created endpoints
Infra (Priya Rao): suggest adding toggle to skip EIP creation for ephemeral test environments to avoid cost surprises
testing_plan: Unit tests: terraform validate + terraform plan diffs in CI for variations (nat_gateway vs nat_instance)
Integration tests: deploy to sandbox account with three AZs, assert endpoints and routes, run synthetic probe and assert monitor logs
Canary upgrade: deploy old module version, run traffic against read-only workload, upgrade module in a single AZ, observe metrics and failover behavior
rollback_plan: If an upgrade causes route instability, revert module version, re-apply state, and re-run synthetic probes. For traffic-impacting failures, insert temporary static route via provider console and open an incident for immediate remediation.
notes: Goal is to reduce duplicated IaC patterns across customer private deployments and produce a well-tested, documented module
This module will be recommended default for Dedicated and Private customers unless they opt for a custom topology
implementation_tasks: Define module input schema and defaults
Implement synthetic probe (Lambda or Fargate) and exporter
Document upgrade/migration steps in release notes
